messages:
ajay: Postmortem follow-up: authz incident (token validation bypass). I pulled the notes into the doc linked below. We need owners for: token validation library upgrade, audit-logging backfill, and secrets rotation. TL;DR: root cause = old validation shim + missing audit hooks in legacy proxy.

security-bot: Incident doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/authz-1799002468 — severity P2, mitigated. (automated)

maria: I can take token validation library upgrade. Estimate 3 sprint days to finish upgrade + tests. Will need help with canonical test vectors from SRE.

jamie: I will own audit-logging backfill. Plan: 1) write migration to backfill events for last 30d, 2) add missing hooks to proxy, 3) verify via sampling. ETA EOW next week.

oliver: Secrets rotation: we should rotate the long-lived signing keys and audit the usage. I propose rotating two keys this week and schedule automated rotation monthly. Need security review for KMS policy changes.

ajay: Thanks. Can each owner add a single-line JIRA and target date here? I'll consolidate into the remediation tracker and push to the sprint. Also note recurring pattern: this is third token-related alert in 6 months — propose recurring audit every 30 days and an alert on library version drift.

maria: JIRA: INF-4321. Target: 2026-04-05. Blocking: need the new unit test harness from jamie (to validate edge cases).

jamie: JIRA: SEC-2157. Target: 2026-04-08. I'll add test harness and a smoke test that runs in staging pre-deploy.

oliver: JIRA: OPS-7780. Target: 2026-04-02 for key rotations; monthly rotation automation by 2026-04-20. Need approval from people-ops for rotation window impacting SSO.

ajay: Remote action items summary (for tracker):
- token-validation library upgrade -> owner: maria -> JIRA INF-4321 -> ETA 2026-04-05 -> blockers: test harness
- audit-logging backfill -> owner: jamie -> JIRA SEC-2157 -> ETA 2026-04-08 -> blockers: sampling query + staging runbook
- secrets/key rotation -> owner: oliver -> JIRA OPS-7780 -> ETA 2026-04-02 -> blockers: KMS ACL review
- recurring audits + alerts -> owner: ajay -> JIRA OPS-7781 -> ETA 2026-04-06 -> add to chef/monitoring

maria: Quick notes about validation tests: include cases for expired tokens, tokens with unknown kid, and token reuse within 1s window. I'll post test vectors here later today.

jamie: For backfill, I'll run migration in staging first with subset=true and validate counts. I'll share the staging query and the expected deltas before doing prod run.

oliver: KMS review scheduled with security@ 2026-03-30 1400 PT. I'll paste the meeting notes after. If approved we rotate keys on 2026-04-02 during the 01:00-02:00 UTC window.

sre-oncall: Heads-up: add an alert when token library package version != pinned_version in deployment manifests. I can add manifest scan job to CI.

ajay: Good. Two more follow-ups: 1) update runbook with rollback steps for the validation library; 2) add audit-check dashboard (last 90 days, event gaps). Who wants which?

jamie: I'll update runbook with rollback steps and the staging validation checklist.

maria: I'll own the audit-check dashboard — will need access to analytics team index. ETA 2026-04-07.

ajay: Perfect. Let's reconvene next Tuesday 10:00 PT for a short sync — bring updates and any blockers. I'll add calendar invite and link to the tracker.

security-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-up checklist auto-created: https://redwood.internal/remediation-tracker/INF-4321 (automated)

oliver: Quick note: add a test that fails on missing audit-hook header in the proxy. That would have caught this.

maria: Yep — adding that to unit tests now.

ajay: Thanks everyone. If any ETA slips, @mention me in the JIRA comment. I'll convert unresolved blockers into escalation tasks before the next sync. :thumbsup:

jamie: :thumbsup: will post the staging migration query by EOD.

oliver: :rotating_light: I'll update when KMS review completes.

sre-oncall: Added manifest scan job draft: https://go.redwood/ci/checks/manifest-version-scan — will open PR by tomorrow.

ajay: Closing thread for now — thread will remain open for quick check-ins. I'll update the tracker after today's notes.
